items.briefing:
Global crime syndicates are increasingly using AI tools to automate and scale fraud operations, with autonomous AI agents predicted to drive up to 90% of fraud activity by 2028. This is a growing concern for Australian organisations, as AI-powered scams become harder to detect and can target staff and customers at scale through convincing fake emails, messages, and calls.

To protect your organisation, remind staff to verify unexpected requests — especially those involving money transfers, login credentials, or personal information — through a second, trusted channel before acting. If something feels off, trust that instinct and report it.

featured.title: Autonomous AI agents could drive 90% of fraud by 2028
featured.quote: AI-driven fraud could dominate scam losses within three years, threatening Australian businesses and consumers significantly.
